title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The final temperature of Neptune must be correctly calculated as 52 K.

title: Assumptions Stated
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly state reasonable assumptions about Neptune's surface and atmosphere.

title: Correct Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the correct equations for radiation flux and equilibrium conditions.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Calculation Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show all necessary steps in the calculation leading to the final answer.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of constants.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or alternative methods for estimating temperature.
